title: Result Envelope v1
description: Standard output contract of the Runtime Task Bus (Plan 6). Every dispatched task produces a Result Envelope matching this schema, persisted in the Task Bus database (runtime/tasks.db). Semantics of status: COMPLETED = normal successful completion; FAILED = execution error; BLOCKED = dependencies not completed, model unassigned (MODEL_UNASSIGNED), or route prerequisite not satisfied; CANCELLED = protocol-reserved only, Plan 6 does NOT implement a real cancel tool.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. Fixed to 1 for Result Envelope v1. Any breaking schema change must bump this value (see templates/AGENTS.md).

task_id.description: task_id of the Task Envelope this result belongs to.

project_id.description: Target business project identifier, copied from the Task Envelope.

route.description: Route used for dispatch, copied from the Task Envelope.

target_role.description: Agent role resolved by the Task Bus from the route (per framework-config/routing.yaml). May be absent or null when the route could not be resolved to a role.

status.description: Terminal or blocking status of the task. COMPLETED = normal completion in Plan 6 runtime; FAILED = execution exception; BLOCKED = dependency not completed, model unassigned (MODEL_UNASSIGNED), or route prerequisite not satisfied; CANCELLED = protocol compatibility reservation only, no cancel tool is implemented in Plan 6.

session_id.description: OpenCode session id in which the task was executed, when applicable. Null if the task never reached a session (e.g. BLOCKED before dispatch).

session_generation.description: Generation number of the executing session (per the Runtime Session Registry), when applicable. Null if not available.

output_text.description: Main textual output of the task execution.

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced by the task (e.g. file paths, commit references, report locations). Kept lightweight; no embedded secrets.

risks.description: Risks or caveats reported by the executor that the caller should be aware of.

error.description: Error description when status is FAILED or BLOCKED. Null on normal completion.

started_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time) when execution started.

finished_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time) when execution finished.
